description: Go implementation of an Avalanche node.
readme_summary: Node implementation for the Avalanche network - a blockchains platform with high throughput, and blazing fast transactions. Avalanche is an incredibly lightweight protocol, so the minimum computer requirements are quite modest. Note that as network usage increases, hardware requirements may change. The minimum recommended hardware specification for nodes connected to Mainnet is: - CPU: Equivalent of 8 AWS vCPU - RAM: 16 GiB - Storage: 1 TiB - Nodes running for very long periods of time or nodes with custom configurations may observe higher storage requirements. - OS: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 or macOS >= 12 - Network: Reliable IPv4 or IPv6 network connection, with an open public port.
